customManagers.description: Update Node.js version in Dockerfiles. The optional prefix matches registry-qualified base images such as hmctsprod.azurecr.io/base/node
Update Node.js version in GitHub Actions

packageRules.description: Never automerge a major. Breaking changes need a human to read the changelog
Keep @types/node on the runtime major in .nvmrc. Types ahead of the runtime describe APIs that are not there. Raise this bound when Node's major changes
Hold the Welsh extractor's TypeScript alias on 6.x. TypeScript 7 dropped the JavaScript compiler API that scripts/extract-welsh-strings.mjs parses with; the build's own typescript moves freely

Never automerge pdfjs-dist: package.json resolves it through .yarn/patches/pdfjs-dist-npm-6.4.299-*.patch, which fails a page holding an image over maxImageSize (worker) and makes that render reject (display) (docs/pdfjs-render-error-upstream-issue.md). A bump drops the patch, and src/assets/js/document-viewer/pdf-document.test.ts then fails. Re-apply the patch to the new version with yarn patch on the original package; only the display hunks can go once upstream rejects the render itself
Auto-merge Node.js minor and patch updates
Require approval for Node.js major updates. Redundant with the global major rule, but stated last so it also governs a grouped branch that mixes update types
